issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release v2.0.0 Section 5.2.4, ofType(type : type specifier)
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-04 HISTORIAN probe found native fhirpath_is_valid('entry.resource.ofType()') returned true while forced Python fallback returned false. Section 5.2.4 requires a type specifier argument.
issues.root_cause: Native Evaluator::evalOfType returned an empty collection when the AST had no type-argument child, so fhirpath_is_valid treated missing ofType arguments as valid empty evaluation.
issues.resolution: Changed native evalOfType to require exactly one type argument and throw FHIRPathSpecError otherwise; added native/fallback parity and native sqllogictest regression coverage; rebuilt and copied bundled extension.
issues.verified_in: FP-04 HISTORIAN iteration 1: post-fix probe 26/26; pytest test_filter_projection_parity.py 6/6; native extension unittest 350 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822.
